service.description: Stores the Chatter and record files of the demo request, task and event (IronStone M3), so their timelines and files have content: on the request (BOSS_DEMO_REQUEST) two notes, an email from Bob Acme with its quoted text, a call done, a status change, two files (a text file and a picture of the calendar) and two followers (john.doe and Joe Developer), with the planned call of load#CommonsDemo; on the task (BOSS_DEMO_TASK) a note, an email to send in two days, a to-do done and a file; on the event (BOSS_DEMO_EVENT) a note, a to-do in three days and an agenda. The past entries have fixed dates in October 2026, the planned ones are dated from the load, each at its time of day in john.doe's time zone (the user's when a user runs it); nothing notifies anyone. Only BOSS_DEMO_* records are written; loading again moves the planned dates.

The emails john.doe sent that Commons Contacts lists under Recently contacted (IronStone M4), dated from the load: to his personal contact Robin Fischer three days ago and to Pat Quinn six days ago. Only BOSS_DEMO_CE_CONTACT_* records are written; loading again moves their dates.
Records the approval of a demo purchase as a note on its record.
Records the refusal of a demo purchase, with its reason, as a note on its record.
